titre: Part des cartes dans les paiements américains
sous_titre: en % du nombre de paiements scripturaux, 2015 à 2024

2015.texte: Cards' share of noncash payments reached 79 percent in 2024, up from 77 percent in 2021 and 71 percent in 2015.

2021.texte: Cards' share of noncash payments reached 79 percent in 2024, up from 77 percent in 2021 and 71 percent in 2015.

2024.texte: Cards continued to dominate noncash payments by number, comprising nearly four-fifths of all transactions in 2024.
